hero.description: I've been leading engineering teams and building scalable systems for 10 years. Currently VP of Engineering at Akieni, ex-CTO at Cowema. I help organizations build robust tech infrastructure, optimize operations, and scale their engineering capabilities.
about.label: ABOUT
about.heading: Building teams & systems that scale
about.description_1: I've spent the last decade building and leading engineering teams across Africa. Started as a freelance developer in 2015, became CTO at Cowema where I built a marketplace platform from scratch to 30K+ users, and now I'm VP of Engineering at Akieni managing 18+ engineers across Backend, Frontend, Mobile, and UI/UX.
about.description_2: My focus is building enterprise-grade systems across GovTech, E-Commerce, and HealthTech—from cloud architecture and data pipelines to mobile applications and API design. I've trained multiple junior developers to senior level, unblocked stalled government projects, and delivered high-performance, secure platforms serving thousands of users.
about.description_3: I work across the full stack—from defining technical strategy in the boardroom to architecting solutions that scale. If you're scaling a team, modernizing your stack, or need hands-on leadership to deliver something critical, let's talk.

services.label: SERVICES
services.heading: How I can help
services.description: Strategic guidance and hands-on execution for your technical challenges
services.technical_strategy.title: Technical Strategy
services.technical_strategy.subtitle: Architecture & Planning
services.technical_strategy.description: Choosing between microservices and monoliths? Evaluating a new stack? Planning a migration? I help you make technical decisions that align with your business goals and scale sustainably. I've architected systems for government agencies, 30K+ user marketplaces, and enterprise platforms—let me help you build a roadmap that actually works.
services.engineering_leadership.title: Engineering Leadership
services.engineering_leadership.subtitle: Team Building & Management
services.engineering_leadership.descript: Need to scale your team while maintaining quality? I've scaled teams from 7 to 17+ engineers at Akieni, trained juniors to senior level at COWEMA, and built hiring processes that work. Whether you're structuring your first team or scaling past 10 engineers, I help you grow without chaos.
services.system_design.title: System Design & Migration
services.system_design.subtitle: Software Architecture & Design Patterns
services.system_design.description: Modernizing your application or planning a complex migration? I've architected scalable software systems, designed microservices architectures, and migrated monolithic applications to modern patterns. From domain-driven design to clean architecture, I build solutions that evolve with your business—pragmatic decisions over hype.
services.fullstack_development.title: Interim CTO / Technical Leadership
services.fullstack_development.subtitle: Hands-On Leadership & Execution
services.fullstack_development.descripti: Need hands-on technical leadership while you scale? I step in as interim CTO/VP to build your engineering foundation, hire and lead your first team, establish processes that last, and deliver critical projects. Not just strategy—I roll up my sleeves, architect solutions, and ship products that work.
services.technical_consulting.title: Technical Consulting
services.technical_consulting.subtitle: Code Review & Advisory
services.technical_consulting.descriptio: Facing a complex technical decision or need validation on your approach? I provide hands-on consulting: architecture reviews, code audits, technology evaluation, and strategic guidance. Think of me as your technical advisor who's actually built what you're trying to build.
